members: private final Map<String, DeviceState> devices = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

public SequencingService(Duration reorderWindow, int reorderBufferCapacity, Duration windowSize, Duration windowSlide, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetrySampleEvent> sequencedSamples, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetryBackfillDetectedEvent> backfillDetections, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetryWindowClosedEvent> closedWindows) { this.reorderWindow = Objects.requireNonNull(reorderWindow, "reorderWindow"); this.reorderBufferCapacity = reorderBufferCapacity; this.windowSize = Objects.requireNonNull(windowSize, "windowSize"); this.windowSlide = Objects.requireNonNull(windowSlide, "windowSlide"); this.sequencedSamples = Objects.requireNonNull(sequencedSamples, "sequencedSamples"); this.backfillDetections = Objects.requireNonNull(backfillDetections, "backfillDetections"); this.closedWindows = Objects.requireNonNull(closedWindows, "closedWindows"); }

public Mono<Void> onSampleReceived(TelemetrySampleEvent sample) { return Mono.defer(() -> { Objects.requireNonNull(sample, "sample"); DeviceState state = devices.computeIfAbsent(sample.deviceId(), id -> new DeviceState(new ReorderWindow(reorderWindow, reorderBufferCapacity), new SlidingWindowAssembler(windowSize, windowSlide))); List<Mono<Void>> publications = new ArrayList<>(); synchronized (state) { ReorderWindow.Outcome outcome = state.reorder.offer(sample); if (outcome == ReorderWindow.Outcome.BACKFILL) { publications.add(backfillDetections.publish(new TelemetryBackfillDetectedEvent(sample, false))); } else if (outcome == ReorderWindow.Outcome.LATE) { publications.add(backfillDetections.publish(new TelemetryBackfillDetectedEvent(sample, true))); } for (TelemetrySampleEvent ready : state.reorder.drainReady()) { publishOrdered(state, ready, publications); } } return Flux.concat(publications).then(); }); }

private void publishOrdered(DeviceState state, TelemetrySampleEvent ready, List<Mono<Void>> publications) { publications.add(sequencedSamples.publish(ready)); for (TelemetryWindowClosedEvent window : state.assembler.add(ready)) { publications.add(closedWindows.publish(window)); } }

private static final class DeviceState { private final ReorderWindow reorder; private final SlidingWindowAssembler assembler; private DeviceState(ReorderWindow reorder, SlidingWindowAssembler assembler) { this.reorder = reorder; this.assembler = assembler; } }
